senses.gloss: नीप (I) m. 1. The foot of a mountain; 2. the kadamba tree (according to poets, this tree blossoms in the rainy season, सीमंते च स्वदुपगमजं यत्र नीपं वधूनाम् Megh.ii.2); 3. a species of aśoka; 4. race of kings, R.vi.46.
नीप (II) n. The flower of the kadamba tree, Megh.i.21, R.xix.37, Megh.ii.2.
निपतन n. Falling down, descending. alighting.
निपातन n. 1. Throwing down, knocking down, M.xi.208; 2. overthrowing, destroying, killing; 3. an irregular form of a word, an irregularity.
निपत्या f. 1. Slippery ground; 2. a battle-field.

निपात m. 1. Falling down, descending, alighting, पयोधरोत्सेधनिपातचूर्णिताः K.S.v.24; 2. attacking, R.ii.60; 3. casting, hurling, K.S.iii.15; 4. death, M.vi.31; 5. accidental occurrence or mention; 6. irregular form, irregularity, e.g. परनिपात, पूर्वनिपात; 7. a particle, an indeclinable (in gram.).
निपान n. 1. Drinking off; 2. any reservoir of water, a pool, a puddle, गाहंतां महिषा निपानसलिलं शृंगैर्मुहुस्ताडितम् Sak.ii.; 3. a well; 4. a milk-pail.
निपीडन n. 1. Squeezing, pressing; 2. hurting, injuring.

निपुण a. (f. णा) 1. Clever, shrewd, skilful, अतिमलिने कर्तव्ये भवति खलानामतीव निपुणा धीः Vas.D.; 2. skilled in, conversant with, (with a loc.); 3. kindly or friendly towards; 4. sharp, fine, delicate; 5. complete, perfect, accurate.(The acc. and inst. singulars viz., निपुणम् and निपुणेन are used as indeclinables in the sense of- (1) skilfully, cleverly; (2) completely, totally; (3) exactly, carefully, accurately, e.g. न निपुणं निरीक्षितमायुष्मता; (4) in a delicate manner.)

निपुण a. (f. णा) 1. Clever, shrewd, skilful, अतिमलिने कर्तव्ये भवति खलानामतीव निपुणा धीः Vas.D.; 2. skilled in, conversant with, (with a loc.); 3. kindly or friendly towards; 4. sharp, fine, delicate; 5. complete, perfect, accurate.(The acc. and inst. singulars viz., निपुणम् and निपुणेन are used as indeclinables in the sense of- (1) skilfully, cleverly; (2) completely, totally; (3) exactly, carefully, accurately, e.g. न निपुणं निरीक्षितमायुष्मता; (4) in a delicate manner.)
